name: ramie-fathy-personal-website
description: Personal website for Dr. Ramie Fathy - hosted on GitHub Pages

scripts.test: echo "GitHub Pages static hosting - no build process needed" && exit 0
scripts.clinic:scheduler:build: babel site/public/apps/clinic-scheduler-pro/src/main.jsx --out-file site/public/apps/clinic-scheduler-pro/assets/main.js --presets @babel/preset-react && babel site/public/apps/clinic-scheduler-pro/src/main-animated.jsx --out-file site/public/apps/clinic-scheduler-pro/assets/main-animated.js --presets @babel/preset-react && rm -rf site/public/apps/clinic-scheduler-pro/assets/lib && mkdir -p site/public/apps/clinic-scheduler-pro/assets/lib && cp -R site/public/apps/clinic-scheduler-pro/src/lib/* site/public/apps/clinic-scheduler-pro/assets/lib/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.skinoculars:build: npm --prefix site/public/apps/Skinoculars install && npm --prefix site/public/apps/Skinoculars run build
scripts.test:unit: echo 'Unit tests will be configured in Phase 3' && exit 0
scripts.test:e2e: npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth 'npx playwright test --reporter=list'
scripts.clinic:smoke: npm run test:unit && npm run clinic:scheduler:build && npm test --prefix functions-backend && node functions-backend/verify-functions.js && python -m compileall services/ai-scribe

author: Dr. Ramie Fathy

dependencies.firebase: Client SDK for Firebase Authentication/Firestore used by clinic-scheduler-pro

removed.firebase-tools: Moved to site/package.json for emulator support
